scripts.build: rm -rf engine/dist && tsc -p engine && chmod +x engine/dist/bin/integrity.mjs
scripts.build:check: npm run build && { out=$(git status --porcelain -- engine/dist); [ -z "$out" ] || { echo "engine/dist is out of date or uncommitted:"; echo "$out"; exit 1; }; }
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run audit && npm run build:check
